feeds.title: Inside F2
feeds.description: InsideF2.com is part of the Relvovo Media Group founding in 2017 and based in the United Kingdom to support our wider group. InsideF2.com aims to be the number one independent FIA Formula 2 news platform and community.

feeds.title: Feeder Series » Formula 2
feeds.description: Feeder Series started in 2019 with one simple mission: to bring you the best possible coverage of feeder series in Europe, the United States and Asia. Find the latest news coverage from Formula 2, drivers, events and more here.

feeds.title: RACER » Formula 2
feeds.description: The RACER Channel is the official video channel of RACER Magazine and RACER.com. RACER's top team of international auto racing journalists cover IndyCar, Formula 1, NASCAR, sports car racing and more. Keep informed about the latest news in Formula 2, races, events and more!

feeds.title: F1 Chronicle » Formula 2 News
feeds.description: Your hosts George Howson and Ruby Price bring years of F1 experience to the show, and they are joined by a panel of guests each week to dissect the latest races with their expert analysis that is based on emotion and personal preference, with a sprinkling of facts. George, Ruby and the team hit the apex of all the topics that are causing a stir in F1 right now. Check out their discussions and the latest stories in Formula 2 racing here.

feeds.title: Las Motorsport » FIA F2
feeds.description: Las Motorsport is the premier magazine for motorsport racing enthusiasts around the world. We cover all of the major racing series: F1, F2, F3, GT World and WEC. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just getting started, we have something for everyone. Explore exciting stories, interviews, and insider knowledge from the world's top drivers and teams in F2.

feeds.title: RaceFans » Formula 2
feeds.description: Formula 2 is considered the foremost single-seater feeder series to Formula 1. Explore whats happening in F2, events, news and more! RaceFans is an independent motorsport news website. It was founded in 2005 by editor Keith Collantine under the name F1 Fanatic, and became RaceFans in 2018.
